title: Moving the sine wave by mentally humming a tone
place_text: Undisclosed facility near the NSA complex, Maryland

tellings.quote: looking at the box. When I saw the the the sine wave move, it it is like it came into focus.

plain: A former sergeant named Dan Sherman says that between 1990 and 1993, at an undisclosed site near the NSA's complex in Maryland, he was trained to move a sine wave on a monitor just by humming a tone in his mind. He tells Michels he was watching the box when the wave moved, and "it is like it came into focus"; he also wrote about this in his book Above Black. He describes it as part of training to communicate with aliens by thought, which would mean the NSA treated such contact as real.
